title: Transduction of a leading bit
statement: For every state $q$, bit $b$, and finite bit string $w$, processing $bw$ from state $q$ outputs the bit obtained by swapping $b$ according to $q$, followed by the result of processing $w$ from the next state determined by $q$ and $b$: $T_q(bw)= igl(	ext{swap}_q(b) igr)T_{	ext{next}(q,b)}(w)$.
